pylons_vi: 2 tháp hình giọt nước (vòm nhọn) bê tông, cao ≈119 m (60 m trên mặt cầu); chân tháp thu hẹp dưới mặt cầu, một dầm ngang
pylons_en: 2 'water-drop' pointed-arch concrete pylons, ≈119 m (60 m above deck); legs converge below the deck, one strut

model3d.notes: Main bridge 137.5 + 250 + 137.5 m (525 m, T37–T40), extradosed 5-web PSC box, 27 m deck. 'Giọt nước' pylons: pointed Gothic arch straddling the deck, 60 m above the deck, ≈119 m total; legs converge below the deck to a 48 × 26 m elliptical cap, one strut. Two planes of semi-fan stays through saddles, ≈12 per side per plane (count read from the 10/2026 aerial; press: 48 bó). Deck closed 24/7/2026. Water at 0; deck ≈54 m at T37/T40, 59 m at the pylons, 60.5 m at mid-span (55 m clearance).

pylon_custom.description: 'Giọt nước' (water-drop / flame) pylon at T38 and T39: two hollow-box concrete legs in the transverse plane. From a stadium pile cap they rise and splay outward to just outside the deck edges (z ≈ ±16 at deck level), joined below the deck by one transverse strut, then curve inward above the deck to a POINTED apex 60 m above the deck (Gothic arch). Two near-vertical planes of semi-fan stays run through saddles in the upper legs to the deck edges.

notes: r9: pointed (Gothic) apex, solid tip ('giọt nước'); deck closed 24/7/2026 (G16), main-side stays 24–105 m (G15).
